admission.justification: Document components and page policy jointly prevent forbidden media fetches and referrer disclosure across fetch-bearing attributes that have different browser APIs.

applicability: Fetch-bearing media addresses in rendered repository documents, including images, source sets, video sources, posters and nested source elements.
conditions: Repository-relative media addresses resolve against the current document context.
External fetched media addresses use HTTPS.
Source sets are tokenized before each parsed candidate receives the media address policy.
The page's no-referrer policy covers media elements without a per-element referrer-policy attribute.
exclusions: Raw HTML in notes, cards or task prose, which keeps ordinary Markdown behavior.
Non-media hyperlinks, whose outside navigation policy is separate.
